column1: Yandy Diaz leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a favorable home matchup against Patrick Sandoval, further boosted by a platoon edge and a hitter-friendly park. Josh Naylor also stands out thanks to a hot recent stretch and a solid park boost in Colorado, making him a reliable secondary option. Junior Caminero’s consistency in games with a hit keeps him in the mix, but Diaz’s combination of matchup and track record sets him apart for Beat The Streak selections.
